title: Estée Lauder Companies names Mattel veteran Senior VP, Global Marketing, at Clinique
summary: Krista Lee Berger, previously Senior VP and Global Head of Barbie & Dolls at Mattel, has been appointed Senior VP, Global Marketing, at Clinique, responsible for the skin care brand’s global marketing strategies
